name: Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Visitors must first obtain an Extension of Stay from Immigration before a residence permit application can be made.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain an Extension of Stay from Immigration first.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a banker's statement of financial position, or a letter from a friend/family member in Dominica accepting responsibility for the applicant if unemployed.
Requires a recent police record and two testimonials (one from a last employer, where applicable).

evidence_required.document: Valid passport (6+ months validity), 2 completed application forms, medical form (incl. HIV test, chest X-ray)
Two testimonials, one from last employer
Proof of return ticket or travel-cost deposit
Cover letter requesting the permit; letter from friend/family accepting responsibility, if unemployed

sources.title: Government of Dominica Web Portal -- How Do I Apply for a Residence Permit?

notes: NEW COUNTRY, first Dominica route. This is a single, broadly discretionary 'Residence Permit' status (non-work), distinct from dm_work_permit (employment-based, which itself confers residency after 6+ months per source) and dm_permanent_residence (the 5-year settled status). category set to 'visit' as the closest existing enum fit for a general non-work temporary residence status; this dataset's category enum has no dedicated 'general temporary residence' bucket. HONEST GAP: the source page does not state the permit's duration, nor does it break out distinct qualifying grounds (e.g. spouse of a resident) with different requirements -- a marriage certificate is listed only as a conditional supporting document, not as its own qualifying pathway, so no separate family-based requirement group was invented here. family_can_join set false as a conservative default: no dependant-sponsorship right of this permit's own was described in the source (a spouse would need their own qualifying basis). Fee: EC$250 (CARICOM) / EC$800 (non-CARICOM).
